messages:
Ivy: Quick one  small, measurable copy pass for Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing heroes. Goal: boost meaningful signups and split inbound by intent (trial vs sales). Who can draft tight variants?
Rory: I can take headlines + CTA microcopy. thinking short, factual, no fluff.
Sam: add me for measurement. we should track both webinar opt-ins and demo request conversions separately.
Devon: product notes: Dedicated must mention reserved GPUs + SLA. Private needs KMS + audit logs. Hosted should signal fast time-to-value and curated models.
Lane: proposing hero pairs (short headline + 1-line subhead). examples: Hosted: "Managed inference API10min to first request" subhead: "Curated open models, predictable pricing, immediate SDKs." Dedicated: "Reserved GPU capacity for predictable throughput" subhead: "SLA-backed latency, autoscaling pools." Private: "Deploy inference inside your VPC with KMS control" subhead: "On-prem options and audit logs for regulated workloads."
Ivy: good. CTAs: Hosted -> "Start free trial"; Dedicated -> "Request reserved capacity"; Private -> "Contact our sales team". Also add small webinar banner: "Webinar: Serving LLMs at scale  June 10 " CTA = "Save my seat".
Rory: CTA microcopy under buttons: Hosted: "No credit card, cancel anytime"; Dedicated: "Short qualification form 1 min"; Private: "Security intake required". keep these visible but concise.
Sam: routing plan (HubSpot)  will implement lists and webhooks:
```
hosted_form -> list: lp_hosted_trial_499555; lead_source=landing_copy_microtest_499555
dedicated_form -> list: lp_dedicated_inq_499555; lead_source=landing_copy_microtest_499555
private_form -> list: lp_private_sales_499555; lead_source=landing_copy_microtest_499555
webinar -> list: webinar_499555; lead_source=landing_copy_microtest_499555_banner
```
RoutingBot: Staging hooks created: https://rwd.test/track/h_499555, https://rwd.test/track/d_499555, https://rwd.test/track/p_499555, webinar: https://rwd.test/track/w_499555. Will validate Wed 10:00 PT.
Devon: Dedicated qual fields: desired qps, expected monthly tokens, preferred region. If tokens > 250M then assign to AE queue. Private requires security contact + SOC2 / FedRAMP notes optionally.
Lane: experiment matrix: 3 hero themes (time-to-value, cost-efficiency, security) x 3 product pages = 9 variants. run split for 72 hours then keep top 3 for another week. utm_campaign=copy_microtest_jun2026, utm_content=hero_{variant}.
Ivy: measurement: impressions, CTR, form submit rate, qualified lead rate, webinar conversion. add heatmap sample for winner variants.
Rory: I'll post 9 headline+subhead drafts by Tue 17:00 PT. keep each line <=10 words for headline and <=20 words for subhead.
Sam: posting baseline metrics now so we can calculate delta. Hosted CTR 2.7%, Dedicated CTR 1.0%, Private CTR 0.6%, webinar banner 0.8%.
Ivy: owners: Rory (copy), Sam (tracking & dashboard), Devon (accuracy + product signoff), Lane (experiment orchestration). Check-in Thu 09:30 to review staging.
Rory: will also include a microcopy row for privacy note: "We use input only to serve requests; we dont train models on your data."
Devon: thumbs up. avoid vague terms like "best" or "industry-leading." use concrete, testable claims.
RoutingBot: Webhooks tested on Wed 10:02 PT. All links returning 200 on staging.
Ivy: great. small ask: when posting variants, add a single line for what success looks like numerically (e.g., +0.5% CTR or +15% qualified leads). keeps A/B decisions clearer.
Lane: noted. see you Thu. :rocket:
